playbook_rules.rule: Never interpolate arbitrary fractional cents when spoken amounts are whole integers; lock integer-dollar display mode unless source evidence explicitly speaks fractional cents.
Maintain ONE canonical visible currency counter per beat; never pair an independent bottom ribbon counter against an active top allocation counter displaying conflicting intermediate numbers.

Every transition between full-frame graphic cutaway and live footage MUST have an explicit rendered incoming or outgoing bridge (paper fold, soft mask unveil, or shared-element morph) rather than an unmotivated hard cut.
Avoid repetitive dark rounded card templates and tiny speaker inset boxes; keep live speaker as full-frame human anchor and reserve cutaways for high-value teaching milestones.
Match sound role to actual visual/semantic context (never engine rev on budget gas, never cash flick on negation or non-monetary counts, never silent cue drops, protect 1-4kHz dialogue).
Never apply bright full-frame light leaks over the speaker's face (max edge glow <= 0.22 opacity with clear center face mask) and keep all text clear of eyes/mouth and phone safe zones.
Display real product UI ONLY from owner-authorized verified ProductAssetCatalog entries; otherwise render honest conceptual illustration explicitly marked ASSET_MISSING_CONCEPTUAL.
